gate: Verify each producer contract and lake lineage before connecting a UI to it.
verification_scope: Static only: every evidence line was read at the pinned commit listed in sources. 'verified' means producer config, lake registration, Bronze path, replay/capture spec, freshness default, API routes and the market-insights-web catalog agree at those commits. No lake object, lake_lineage.json, running API or UI was observed, so runtime_lineage_status is 'unverified' for every product.

owner_decision.owner_answer_verbatim: ทั้งหมด ยกเว้น 140/256 (Recommended)
owner_decision.accepted_option: connect UI only to the 4 verified producers (crypto, stocks, fx, defi).
owner_decision.recorded_only: No UI connection, runtime, registry or status change is made by recording this decision.
open: gap 1 fix route for flights/seo/ai_tools (v3 freeze with public/ paths or move repos back to private/)
gap 3 runtime lineage evidence (Bronze commit manifest per dataset, lake_lineage.json)
gap 4 registry source_paths -> data-lake-pipelines; gap 5 single canonical consumers block

canonical.note: products, endpoints, envelope and policy sections are byte-identical to the vendored copy; only the consumers block (consumer ids/paths) differs

architecture-docs.role: canonical contract (name, commit and sha256 only; private, not vendored and not read by hosted CI)

data-lake-pipelines.role: lake runtime (infra/scripts/data_lake, moved out of solo-empire) and public contract copy

market-data.role: producer monorepo for crypto, stocks, fx, defi

market-insights-web.role: UI consumer named by the gate
